profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Python, Kubernetes, Microservices | AI/ML Integration | GitLab CI/CD | AI-Assisted Dev (Amazon Q, Kiro)
profile.summary:
I engineer and scale distributed systems that handle millions of users and devices daily for global tech and telecommunications leaders. As a hands-on senior engineer, I own the full development lifecycle - from system design and coding to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Over the past 15+ years, I've taken platforms from initial MVPs to production-grade systems serving massive scale:
• 1.25M+ cable modems updated nightly for Spectrum/Charter Communications
• 8M+ active subscribers on digital content platforms across LATAM
• 500K+ monthly bank statements delivered for major financial institutions
• Data center automation workflows for Meta (Facebook)

My expertise lies in bridging complex technical challenges with business needs. I specialize in migrating monoliths to microservices, integrating predictive ML models into critical production environments, and building zero-downtime deployment pipelines.

TECHNICAL TOOLKIT:
• Backend & Languages: Python (Expert), Django, FastAPI, Flask, SQLAlchemy, JavaScript, Dart/Flutter
• DevOps & Cloud Native: Kubernetes, Helm Charts, GitLab CI/CD, Docker, Ansible, Linux
• Distributed Systems & Messaging: Celery, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Apache Thrift, SNMP
• Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, InfluxDB
• AI/ML & Modern Practices: Predictive ML model integration, AI-assisted development (Amazon Q, Kiro)

Currently engineering and scaling critical infrastructure systems for Spectrum/Charter Communications, one of the largest telecommunications providers in the United States. Passionate about leveraging AI tools to accelerate development velocity and eliminate technical debt.

LET'S CONNECT IF YOU'RE INTERESTED IN:
• Distributed systems architecture at scale
• Python backend development & Microservices
• DevOps, Cloud-Native transformations, and CI/CD
• ML integration in production environments

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Software Engineer IV)
positions.description:
Engineering and scaling critical infrastructure for Spectrum/Charter Communications. Hands-on senior engineer owning the full software development lifecycle, from design and coding to deployment and monitoring of distributed systems and full-stack internal platforms.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS:
• Built a zero-downtime, 24/7 firmware validation system using SNMP. Integrated predictive ML models to unlock business-constrained maintenance windows for autonomous operations.
• Engineered a distributed firmware automation system processing 1.25M+ cable modems nightly via batch orchestration, achieving a 90%+ success rate.
• Executed critical components of a monolith-to-microservices migration, developing core backend services that improved scalability and deployment velocity.
• Designed GitLab CI/CD pipelines, orchestrating automated multi-environment deployments using Kubernetes and Helm Charts.
• Built and integrated backend APIs (Django/FastAPI) and frontend interfaces (React) for an internal CPE management platform, providing real-time monitoring, analytics, and operational tools for millions of deployed devices.
• Spearheaded comprehensive refactoring of legacy code, migrating raw SQL to SQLAlchemy (ORM) and leveraging AI tools (Amazon Q, Kiro) to eliminate technical debt.
• Enhanced deployment safety with role-based filters, VIP protection lists, and Canary Deployments with automated rollbacks.

TECH STACK: Python, Django, React, FastAPI, Kubernetes, Helm, GitLab CI/CD, Docker, SQLAlchemy, SNMP, Microservices, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Celery, RabbitMQ. AI, ML Integration, Amazon Q, Kiro.

positions.title: Senior Python Engineer (Python Engineer V)
positions.description:
Engineered automation and infrastructure services for large-scale data center applications at Meta (Facebook). Focused on building resilient systems, zero-touch provisioning, and autonomous server recovery to support massive operational scale.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS:
• Engineered automated pre-production testing workflows using Python and Apache Thrift to validate server health and autonomous recovery capabilities, ensuring zero-touch provisioning before production deployment.
• Developed robust Python automation workflows for data center service provisioning, significantly reducing manual operational overhead and accelerating deployment velocity.
• Built and integrated API endpoints for real-time health checks and monitoring of critical data center services, ensuring high availability and rapid incident response.
• Maintained high code quality and deployment reliability through rigorous code reviews, resolving critical bugs, and managing seamless production deployments.
• Designed and developed comprehensive metrics dashboards to provide real-time visibility into data center operations, facilitating data-driven decision-making across cross-functional teams.

TECH STACK: Python, Apache Thrift, REST APIs, Automation, CI/CD, Data Center Infrastructure, Zero-Touch Provisioning, Metrics & Dashboards.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Veracruz de Ignacio de la Llave, México
positions.description:
Engineered and scaled enterprise integration solutions for an e-invoicing platform authorized by the Mexican Tax Administration Service (SAT) as an Authorized Certification Provider (PAC). Worked with major financial institutions and corporate clients, ensuring strict compliance with government regulations and financial security standards. Owned the full development lifecycle from system design and API integration to deployment and monitoring of high-volume document delivery systems.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS:
• Engineered end-to-end integration of 3 major corporate clients into the SAT-authorized e-invoicing platform, including 2 financial institutions (banks) and a national automotive dealership network, ensuring strict compliance with Mexican tax regulations and security standards.
• Architected and scaled a high-volume document delivery system processing 500K+ monthly bank statements, supporting multi-channel distribution (Email, FTP, SFTP, Web Services) with real-time delivery tracking and guaranteed confirmation.
• Integrated third-party REST and SOAP APIs into the invoicing platform, enabling seamless connectivity with external financial systems and expanding enterprise capabilities.
• Designed, developed, and maintained a robust email delivery service with integrated tracking, directly linked to the core invoicing platform to ensure auditability and compliance with SAT requirements.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot production issues, optimize system performance, and ensure 99.9% uptime for critical financial document delivery.

TECH STACK: Python, Django, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, SOAP, FTP/SFTP, Email Services, Multi-channel Delivery, Financial Compliance, SAT Regulations, ETL, Linux

positions.title: Web and Mobile Administrator
positions.description:
Engineered and scaled a digital content monetization platform serving 8M+ active subscribers across Mexico and LATAM. Owned the full development lifecycle from system design and telecom integrations to deployment, monitoring, and optimization of high-traffic subscription-based services processing 20M+ MXN monthly in micro-transactions.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS:
• Architected and scaled a digital content platform from MVP to a robust multi-tenant SaaS, supporting multiple subscription-based storefronts across Mexico and LATAM with 8M+ active subscribers.
• Engineered complex Direct Carrier Billing (DCB) integrations with major telecom providers including América Móvil (for LATAM operations), Telcel, Movistar, AT&T, and Nextel, processing 20M+ MXN monthly in micro-transactions with automated retry logic and virtual credit economy for digital media.
• Designed a secure, multi-tenant architecture to simultaneously support competing commercial entities on the same underlying infrastructure, ensuring strict data isolation and compliance while maintaining platform stability at massive scale.
• Redesigned platform architecture to handle massive traffic spikes, implementing comprehensive monitoring systems based on technical and business KPIs to guarantee high availability during peak demand periods.
• Mentored junior developers and interns, fostering a culture of code quality, performing rigorous code reviews, and driving engineering best practices within the team.
• Administered and optimized Linux servers, ensuring high performance and security for the digital content distribution network serving millions of users.

TECH STACK: Python, Django, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Linux, SNMP, Multi-tenant SaaS, Direct Carrier Billing (DCB), REST APIs, Telecom Integrations, High-Availability Systems, Performance Monitoring

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Led the development and scaling of a mobile digital content platform, evolving it from an initial MVP into a full-featured Content Management System (CMS). Owned the full development lifecycle including backend architecture, billing integrations, and Linux server administration.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS:
• Evolved the platform from an MVP into a full-featured Content Management System (CMS) for mobile devices, establishing the foundation for horizontal scaling.
• Designed and implemented a subscription charging system with automated billing cycles and retry logic, successfully processing thousands of micro-transactions weekly.
• Engineered an intelligent content distribution system that dynamically optimized delivery formats (video, audio, images) based on diverse mobile device capabilities, maximizing user experience.
• Created and maintained a bulk SMS campaign service, integrating third-party SMS gateways and APIs to deliver promotional content and subscription notifications at scale.
• Administered and optimized Linux servers, configuring web servers (Nginx, Lighttpd, uWSGI) and managing system processes (Daemons, Cronjobs) to ensure high platform stability.
• Mentored junior developers, performing code reviews and fostering a culture of continuous learning and engineering best practices.

TECH STACK: Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Linux, Nginx, uWSGI, REST/SOAP APIs, SMS Gateways, CMS, Daemons, Cronjobs

positions.title: Software Developer Jr
positions.description:
Developed the initial MVP for a mobile digital content commerce platform, building core systems from scratch including database architecture, payment processing, and mobile-optimized web applications.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS:
• Developed the initial Minimum Viable Product (MVP) for a mobile digital content platform, establishing the foundation for content catalog management, user subscriptions, and transaction tracking.
• Designed and implemented the relational database schema using PostgreSQL, optimizing queries for content retrieval, subscription management, and transaction processing.
• Built mobile-optimized web applications for feature phones, ensuring compatibility across diverse device capabilities, screen sizes, and browser limitations.
• Integrated payment processing workflows for micro-transactions, enabling users to purchase digital content (images, ringtones, videos) directly through mobile carriers.
• Administered Linux servers, configuring web servers (Apache, Lighttpd) and managing system processes to ensure platform stability and performance.

TECH STACK: Python, PostgreSQL, Linux, Apache, Lighttpd, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Mobile Web Development, Payment Integration, Database Design
